name: inventario-pymes
description: Sistema de Gestión de Inventarios para PYMES (backend Express + frontend React)

scripts.instalar: npm install && npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix frontend install
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,web -c magenta,cyan "npm --prefix backend run dev" "npm --prefix frontend run dev"
scripts.db:setup: npm --prefix backend run db:create && npm --prefix backend run db:migrate && npm --prefix backend run db:seed
